scope: Standalone append journal, not production app history routing
held_findings: Each command copies all base UUIDs, positions and endpoints: memory scales with base size times history depth; requires shared revision identity design.
Spatial index rebuild allocates after mutation; complete allocation-failure atomicity remains unproved.
decision: Accepted into isolated standalone proof in review branch; production integration held on baseline history memory and allocation atomicity.
